resolvedFindings.title: Preserve selected profile statistic when changing history window
reproduction: Select Rushing yards in Player trajectory metric.
Select 5 calendar weeks in Player trajectory history.
resolvedFindings.actual: Metric resets to fantasy_points after profile is cleared and TrajectoryStrip is remounted.
resolvedFindings.cause: Metric state belongs to TrajectoryStrip, but trendWeeks refetch sets profile to null and unmounts it.
resolvedFindings.verification: Fresh independent test failed: expected rushing_yards, received fantasy_points. Root reports correction in progress; not reverified yet.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Trajectory metric now lives in PlayerProfile and is passed to TrajectoryStrip; original independent history-change reproduction passes.

resolvedFindings.title: Discard numeric filters for fields absent from the current table schema
reproduction: Open a player profile Heat Map with two logs (5 and 30 FPTS).
Set numeric filter to FPTS and minimum to 20.
Switch Heat Map stat group to Rushing.
resolvedFindings.expected: New group has no selected numeric filter and shows both logs.
resolvedFindings.actual: Numeric selector displays Any value but the old FPTS filter invisibly remains active; only one log appears.
resolvedFindings.cause: DataTable keeps rangeKey across id/column changes and applies it without checking the current columns.
resolvedFindings.verification: Fresh independent test failed: expected 2 rows, received 1, even while selector value was empty.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Only a numeric range key present in the current columns is applied and displayed; original independent group-switch reproduction passes.

resolvedFindings.title: Provide numeric column types to the Waivers numeric preset
resolvedFindings.expected: Keep source ranks, FAAB amounts, market figures, and statistical numeric columns.
resolvedFindings.actual: Every optional column disappears, leaving only identity fields.
resolvedFindings.cause: TableSettingsPanel numeric preset recognizes column.type, but waiverColumns descriptors identify numeric fields only with kind. Same type gap exists for some Opportunity and participation columns.
resolvedFindings.verification: Fresh independent test failed: Sort Fantasy FPTS absent after preset.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Waivers adapts numeric kind metadata to shared column types. Opportunity, participation, and Intelligence numeric descriptors also corrected and verified with fresh component tests.

resolvedFindings.title: Apply the same waiver column order shown in settings
reproduction: Move FPTS earlier once, across the preceding Receiving trend column.
resolvedFindings.expected: FPTS appears before the Receiving trend as shown in the settings order.
resolvedFindings.actual: FPTS remains after the entire Receiving group.
resolvedFindings.cause: Renderer retains fixed GROUPS order and only sorts members inside each group, so cross-group moves permitted by the shared panel are ignored.
resolvedFindings.verification: Fresh independent test failed: FPTS header index 35 was not before Receiving trend index 34.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Semantic section constraints are explicit in settings, boundary moves are disabled, and allowed within-section moves match rendered order. Revised contract verified by source inspection and regression test.
